meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase event time using "an hour" option succeeds

plan.title: Increase RFQ Submission Time by One Hour

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary with a vendor bid.
Navigate to the RFQ stage where submission-time settings are available.
Open the RFQ Responses tab as specified by the scenario.
Open Extend Submission Time, choose “an hour,” confirm it, and verify the end time moves forward by 60 minutes.
Verify the expected success confirmation appears.
